name: Westminster grounds, former footprint
summary: Former building footprint of unknown identity crossed by a lawn and conifer in the 2025 city image, with no standing roof visible.

evidence.note: The 2025 source image contains uninterrupted grass, a conifer and tree shadows. The mapped roof boundary crosses them.
2019 distant view is largely screened by trees across the grounds. It does not establish a surviving building.
P50 5.21 m, P90 6.06 m, peak 11.83 m. Historical surface returns cannot establish a current roof here.

notes: The survey models the landscape shown in the 2025 orthophoto. The former building has no established name or facade finish.
